exposure: veterinary intervention during the periparturient period
outcome: acceptance of neonates by dam or surrogate after reintroduction
cohort: A total of 193 births from captive western lowland gorillas (Gorilla gorilla gorilla) reported between 1996 and 2016 from 51/53 institutions associated with the Association of Zoos and Aquariums' Gorilla Species Survival Plan.
finding: Veterinary intervention during the periparturient period in captive western lowland gorillas is low, and there is a high rate of acceptance of neonates by either the dam or a surrogate after intervention.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were reported in 3% of births, and advances in captive husbandry and veterinary knowledge have led to a reduced risk of veterinary intervention during gorilla parturition, including C-sections.
